summary: Frontend-only validation of the redesigned SimpleBuilder in GeneratorPanel.jsx. All new UX affordances (numbered Step 1/Step 2, per-line kind switcher, variable chips, live green descriptions) work correctly. Regressions (default WA run, Advanced preview, Settings popover, AI sheet) all pass.

detailed_results.simple_builder_defaults: PASS - var-row-0 (n, int), line-row-0 (vars), line-row-1 (array) rendered
detailed_results.variable_editing: PASS - name edit, type switch (int/float/char/string) toggles correct constraint inputs (decimals/charset/len); green description updates live
detailed_results.add_remove_variable: PASS - add-var-btn adds var-row-1; remove-var-1 removes it
detailed_results.line_kind_switcher: PASS - line-kind-0 switches vars<->array<->const with correct fields shown and description updated
detailed_results.variable_chips: PASS - line-0-chip-n toggles variable in/out of line; description flips to 'Pick which values to print...' when empty
detailed_results.add_line_buttons: PASS - add-line-vars/array/const each add a new correctly-typed line
detailed_results.preview_simple: PASS - preview-btn produced '4\n49 21 4 34\n' consistent with n in [1,8] then n distinct ints in [1,50]
detailed_results.regression_stress_run: PASS - run-stress-test-btn triggers run, WA banner appears, test-row-1 present
detailed_results.regression_advanced: PASS - gen-tab-advanced shows advanced-builder; preview yields valid input

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: SimpleBuilder passes cfg.variables[0].name as the default 'count' for a new Random list line — safe, but users may not realise it references the variable; the green description already clarifies this so no action needed.
Minor: switching a line kind resets its config (defaultLine) which discards user data — intentional but could surprise power users; consider preserving compatible fields.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SimpleBuilder redesign in /app/frontend/src/components/GeneratorPanel.jsx works end-to-end via public URL. Key new testids: line-kind-N (select), line-N-chip-<varname> (toggle chip). Existing testids preserved.
